text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув keeps nodding off during
training
today...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My apologies. Could you repeat that
explanation
once more?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You seem a bit... off.

text_block_list.text:
I haven't been getting much sleep lately.
The
student council work keeps piling
up.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I decided to do a little before bed, but
before I
realized it, the sun was up.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
All the same, the work needs to be
done. Don't
worry—none of this should
be of your concern.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув casually brushes it off, but
she's
clearly exhausted. I should keep
this in mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
